name: Onami Yuuki
source:
He is a ronin student preparing for the university entrance exam and attends a prep school where his mother's sister, Reika, is a teacher.

He has a complex toward his mother and cannot concentrate on his studies.

[From [url=http://www.masterup.net/hina-soft/kuro_hina/kanjyuku/index.html]official site[/url]]
